title: Display device
abstract: The invention discloses a display device, which comprises a first substrate, at least one active element arranged on the first substrate, a dielectric layer arranged on the at least one active element, at least one pixel electrode electrically connected with the at least one active element, a second substrate arranged opposite to the first substrate, a first spacer arranged on the second substrate and a display medium. The dielectric layer has a first protrusion and a body portion outside the first protrusion. At least one pixel electrode is disposed on the main body portion of the dielectric layer. The vertical projection of the first protrusion of the dielectric layer on the first substrate is located within the vertical projection of the first spacer on the first substrate.

title: Display panel, display apparatus, and preparation method for display panel
abstract: The present application discloses a display panel, a display apparatus, and a preparation method for a display panel. The display panel includes a substrate, an isolation structure, a light-emitting layer, and a first encapsulation layer. The first encapsulation layer includes encapsulation portions configured to encapsulate light-emitting units. Orthogonal projections of adjacent encapsulation portions on the substrate overlap to form overlapping regions. The overlapping regions include a first region and a second region, and a width of the first region is different from a width of the second region, for example, the second region has a larger width, that is, adjacent encapsulation portions have a larger overlapping width in the second region.

title: Electronic device and formation method therefor
abstract: An electronic device and a method of forming the same are disclosed. An emitter resonator and a reception cap cavity are formed on and in a first wafer, and an emitter cap cavity and a reception resonator are formed in and on a second wafer. After bonding together the first and second wafers, an emitter filter is formed in an emission region, and a reception filter is formed in a receiving region. The method provided in the present invention not only can simplify the fabrication process of the device and improve its accuracy and stability, but also facilitates integration of the emitter and receives filters in a same chip, which results in a higher degree of integration of the device and a more compact package size thereof.

title: Display panel and display device
abstract: The invention provides a display panel and a display device, wherein a packaging layer of the display panel at least comprises a first organic layer and a first inorganic layer which are arranged in a stacking way, the cross section of the contact surface of the first organic layer and the first inorganic layer is an arc in a corresponding electronic element arrangement area, the arc is positioned on a lighting path of an electronic element, and the center of the arc is positioned on one side of the first inorganic layer; the contact surface of part of the film layer is arranged to be an arc in the electronic element arrangement area, so that part of light rays blocked by the sub-pixel light-emitting unit can pass through a lighting path of the electronic element through refraction of the arc to reach the lighting unit, and the light extraction efficiency of the electronic element to light is improved.

title: Display device and method for fabrication thereof
abstract: A display device is provided. The display device comprises: a plurality of pixel electrodes arranged to be spaced apart from each other on a first substrate; a first light emitting element disposed on one pixel electrode of the plurality of pixel electrodes; a common substrate disposed on the first light emitting element and including a hole; and a second light emitting element disposed in the hole and disposed on another pixel electrode among the plurality of pixel electrodes.

title: Detection method, detection system and storage medium based on artificial intelligence early warning system
abstract: The invention provides a detection method based on an artificial intelligence early warning system, which comprises the following steps: and classifying the monitored objects, and selecting corresponding artificial intelligence models according to the classified categories. And selecting a training sample, and training the selected artificial intelligence model by combining manual adjustment of the residual error overrun trigger threshold range of each measuring point. And applying the trained artificial intelligence model to the monitored object. The detection method based on the artificial intelligent early warning system can reduce the false alarm rate and the missing report rate of the early warning system, so that the early warning system can better play a role. The invention also provides a detection system and a storage medium for executing the detection method.

title: Data acquisition and processing system for power equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a data acquisition and processing system of power equipment, which comprises: a data acquisition module: collecting data information of the power equipment; a data preprocessing module: preprocessing the acquired receipt information to remove defect data and interference; a data format unifying module: extracting the data information after the preprocessing according to a uniform format module and storing the data information into a format module; the data output module is used for sending the data information with unified format to a back-end monitoring system; the technical problem that serious burden is brought to monitoring personnel due to the fact that equipment information formats of the same power equipment are not uniform due to different manufacturers is solved.

title: Vehicle abnormality detection method and system
abstract: The invention provides a vehicle abnormity detection system and method, which comprises an abnormity detection module: detecting the abnormal state of the vehicle through information monitoring of the vehicle equipment, judging whether the vehicle is abnormal or not, if so, stopping the vehicle running, and if not, continuously detecting the abnormality; a data acquisition module: and vehicle operation data are collected in real time and sent to the abnormality detection module. According to the invention, the abnormal state of the vehicle is detected by monitoring the information of the vehicle equipment, so that the running safety of the vehicle is improved; by using abnormal sound detection, false detection caused by data fluctuation of normal operation of the vehicle is prevented; by means of online vehicle operation, data acquisition is carried out, data are analyzed and learned, an abnormal detection method is improved, the accuracy of detection is improved, false detection is prevented, and the stability of vehicle operation is improved.

title: Electric equipment, and dumping detection method, device, equipment and storage medium thereof
abstract: The application relates to a method and a device for detecting electric equipment dumping, dumping detection equipment, electric equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring distance data between a detection position of electric equipment and a reference plane; judging whether the electric equipment is in a toppling state or not according to the distance data; if yes, controlling the electric equipment to stop running. By adopting the method, the state of the electric equipment can be detected, and the electric equipment is controlled to stop running when the electric equipment is detected to be in a toppling state, so that the use safety of the electric equipment is improved.

title: Control system based on integrated controller and engineering machinery
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an integrated controller-based control system and engineering machinery. Belonging to the field of engineering machinery control. The equipment control end comprises a lower end integrated controller, and the lower end integrated controller is used for acquiring and sending working parameters of the engineering machinery, engine operation data and video information of a working area through a wireless network; the remote operation end comprises an upper end integrated controller and audio and video display equipment, and the upper end integrated controller is used for receiving and sending the received working parameters of the engineering machinery, the engine operation data and the video information of the working area through the wireless network; and the sound and video display equipment is used for receiving and displaying the working parameters of the engineering machinery, the engine operation data and the video information which are sent by the upper end integrated controller. The invention reduces components through the function integration of the lower end integrated controller and the upper end integrated controller, saves cost and improves reliability.

title: Anti-PD-1 antibodies and uses thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to anti-PD-1 antibodies and uses thereof, and in particular discloses methods of treating cancer with antibodies and antibody fragments that bind to PD-1.

title: Conjugates to programmed death ligands and uses thereof
abstract: The invention provides a conjugate aiming at programmed death ligand (PD-L1) and application thereof. Specifically, the invention provides a novel anti-PD-L1 monoclonal antibody. The antibody of the invention can be combined with PD-L1 antigen with high specificity, has high affinity, biological activity and low immunogenicity, and is used for preparing medicaments for preventing or treating PD-L1 related diseases.

title: Multi-specific binding proteins for cancer treatment
abstract: The present invention relates to novel DLL3/CD3 binding proteins. The invention also relates to nucleic acids encoding such proteins; to methods for preparing such proteins; to host cells expressing or capable of expressing such proteins; to compositions comprising such proteins; and to uses of such proteins or such compositions, in particular for therapeutic purposes in the field of cancer diseases.

title: Anti-p95her2 antibodies and methods for their use
abstract: The present invention relates to novel anti-p95HER2 antibodies (as monoclonal antibodies or as used in other formats, such as bispecific or multi-specific formats) and compositions comprising such antibodies or cells activated by such antibodies for use in treating disorders associated with p95HER2, such as human cancer therapy.

title: Antibody-conjugated nanoparticles
abstract: The invention relates to antibody conjugates comprising an antibody and a nanoparticle conjugated to the antibody, wherein the nanoparticle comprises a payload, such as a gene editing payload. In some embodiments, the antibody-conjugated nanoparticles provide a means for treating a disease. In some embodiments, the antibody-conjugated nanoparticles are used to correct genetic defects in specific cell populations.

title: Intermetallic compound nano material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an intermetallic compound nano material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the intermetallic compound nano material is hexagonal prism-shaped and consists of three elements of Pt, pb and Sn, has PtPb phase structure, and shows catalytic activity and stability far superior to those of commercial Pd/C catalysts in alcohol oxidation reaction. The invention provides a preparation method of an intermetallic compound nanomaterial, which is efficient and simple, adopts a one-step solvothermal synthesis strategy, has simple process flow, can prepare the nanomaterial with high uniformity in size and excellent dispersibility, and is suitable for mass production.

title: Silicon-carbon negative electrode material modified by magnetic transition metal oxide and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a silicon-carbon negative electrode material modified by magnetic transition metal oxide and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of lithium ion battery micro-nano materials. The preparation method provided by the invention has the advantages of easily available raw materials, low price, simple preparation process flow, easy operation, low energy consumption in the preparation process and environmental friendliness. The prepared silicon-carbon negative electrode material has a uniform and compact modification layer containing magnetic transition metal oxide, and can effectively improve the conductivity, high specific capacity and cycle stability of the silicon-carbon negative electrode material. The initial coulomb efficiency reaches more than 80%, the specific capacity can be stabilized to 1127mAh/g after 100 times of circulation, and the average level of the material is far higher than that of the existing material. In addition, the prepared silicon-carbon anode material has excellent mechanical flexibility, can be directly used for assembling lithium ion batteries, and has strong application potential on flexible wearable electronic devices in the future.

title: Nanometer material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a nano material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, connecting a graphite molded body and a conductive object which are respectively connected with a positive electrode and a negative electrode of a direct current power supply, placing the graphite molded body and the conductive object in electrolyte containing organic alkali, electrolyzing for 1-10 days under the voltage of 25-50V to obtain a first mixture containing carbon points and the organic alkali, S2, mixing a silicon source and an active center source, carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the obtained mixture and the first mixture to obtain a second mixture, S3, cooling the obtained reaction product, carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain a solid-phase product and a liquid-phase product, roasting the solid-phase product to obtain the nano material, and S4, enabling the liquid-phase product to be in contact with a porous material, wherein the pore size of the porous material is larger than that of the nano material. The nano material prepared by the method not only has better catalytic reaction activity, but also can directly discharge the wastewater generated in the preparation process.

title: Nanometer material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method of preparing a nanomaterial and nanomaterial prepared by the method, the method comprising: a. preparing a carbon dot solution; b. uniformly mixing a silicon source, an active center source, organic alkali and optional water to obtain a first mixture; c. mixing the carbon dot solution with the first mixture to perform hydrolysis reaction to obtain a second mixture; d. and carrying out hydrothermal treatment on the second mixture, collecting a solid product, washing, drying and roasting to obtain the nano material. The nano material disclosed by the invention has excellent catalytic activity in the phenol oxidation reaction, and meanwhile, the catalytic stability and repeatability are good.

title: Preparation method of cobaltosic oxide nano material
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of cobaltosic oxide nano material, which uses filter paper as a template to prepare porous flaky Co with special appearance through deposition, drying and sintering processes 3 O 4 The nano material has excellent electrochemical performance and has wide application prospect as a lithium ion battery cathode material. In the whole preparation process, the synthesis method is simple, easy to operate, easy to obtain raw materials, low in equipment investment and suitable for batch production.

title: 3-(5-hydroxy-1-oxoisoindolin-2-yl)piperidine-2,6-dione derivatives and uses thereof
abstract: The present disclosure provides a compound of Formula (I′): or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, hydrate, solvate, prodrug, stereoisomer, or tautomer thereof, wherein R x , X 1 , X 2 , and R 1 are as defined herein, and methods of making and using same.

title: Substituted heteropolycyclic compound, preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of pharmaceutical chemistry, and relates to a substituted heteropolycyclic compound, a pharmaceutical composition containing the same and application thereof. Specifically, the invention relates to a compound shown in a formula (I) and a formula (II) or a pharmaceutically acceptable form thereof, which shows good Wee1 inhibition activity, can be used as a high-efficiency Wee1 inhibitor and is used for preventing and/or treating Wee1 related diseases.

title: Compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a compound with a structure shown in a formula (I) or pharmaceutically acceptable salt, stereoisomer, solvate, hydrate or isotope label thereof, a preparation method of the compound or the pharmaceutically acceptable salt, stereoisomer, solvate, hydrate or isotope label thereof and application of the compound or the pharmaceutically acceptable salt, stereoisomer, solvate, hydrate or isotope label in preparing an iron death inhibitor,

title: Propylene ketone-containing bioinhibitor, preparation method therefor, and use thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a propylene ketone-containing bioinhibitor, a preparation method therefor, and a use thereof. In particular, the present invention relates to the compound represented by each of the general formulas or a stereoisomer thereof, a preparation method therefor, a pharmaceutical composition containing the compound, and a use thereof in the preparation of a drug for treating cancer and other related diseases.

title: Dicarboxylic acid bisamide derivatives, use thereof, pharmaceutical composition based thereon and methods for producing dicarboxylic acid bisamide derivatives
abstract: The present invention relates to novel biologically active compounds, in particular dicarboxylic acid bisamide derivatives of general formula I: or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, which are able to form complexes with or chelate metal ions. The invention also relates to the use of said compounds as an agent for the prevention and/or treatment of cardiovascular, viral, cancer, neurodegenerative and inflammatory diseases, diabetes, age-related diseases, diseases caused by microbial toxins, alcoholism and alcoholic cirrhosis, anaemia, porphyria cutanea tarda, and transition metal salt poisoning. The present invention also relates to novel methods for preparing dicarboxylic acid bisamide derivatives of general formula I.

title: Composite material with modified polypropylene foaming formed body as core layer and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of foaming materials, in particular to a composite material taking a modified polypropylene foaming formed body as a core layer and a preparation method thereof. The invention has simple process, utilizes the compatilizer, the compound nucleating agent and the antioxidant to modify the polypropylene, can improve the adhesiveness of the surface of the polypropylene resin foaming material, and enhances the compounding capability of the polyethylene resin sheet, so that the composite material has high strength performance; the invention uses special mould to polymerize polyethylene resin sheet, and the prepared composite material has smooth surface, no obvious air lock mark and beautiful appearance.

title: Thermoplastic composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a thermoplastic composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the thermoplastic composite material comprises a surface layer material and a framework material; the surface layer material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 30-50 parts of high-fluidity polypropylene resin, 45-50 parts of untwisted continuous glass fiber, 1-8 parts of compatilizer, 0.5-1 part of lubricant, 1-2 parts of antioxidant, 1-8 parts of highlight improver and 1-2 parts of carbon black; the framework material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 20-35 parts of medium-high fluidity polypropylene resin, 50-70 parts of untwisted continuous glass fiber, 1-8 parts of compatilizer, 0.5-1 part of lubricant, 1-2 parts of antioxidant, 1-12 parts of low warpage improver and 1-2 parts of carbon black. The thermoplastic composite material provided by the invention has good mechanical properties, high surface gloss, high strength, low warpage and high temperature resistance, meets the requirements of automobile engine hood cover materials, and realizes the light weight of automobiles.

title: Thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer for film and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of C08L high polymer materials, and in particular provides a thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer for a film and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides a thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer for a film, which is prepared from polyester polyol, polyalcohol compounds, isocyanate, antioxidant, carbodiimide, ultraviolet absorber and the like. Compared with the prior art, the thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer for the film has excellent mechanical properties, has medium and low crystallization speed and reduced water vapor transmittance, and can be processed by film blowing or casting in the process of being used in the film field, so that a new strategy is provided for preparing the polyurethane elastomer with low moisture permeability, and the application range of the thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer is widened.

title: Thermoplastic resin composition
abstract: The present invention relates to a thermoplastic resin composition, which contains an arylene oxide-based polymer; a diene-based rubber graft polymer; an aromatic vinyl-based polymer containing an oxazoline group; and a glycol-based polymer, wherein 5 to 20 wt% of the glycol-based polymer is contained. According to the present invention, it is possible to produce hydrophobic surface-modified silica at low cost through process improvement.

title: Resin composition
abstract: The invention provides a resin composition, which can obtain an insulating layer with low dielectric loss tangent, excellent crack resistance and excellent foaming resistance. The solution of the present invention is a resin composition comprising (A) an organic filler comprising a polymer containing a specific repeating unit, and (B) a curable resin, wherein the average particle diameter of the organic filler (A) is 5 [ mu ] m or less.

title: Preparation method of elsholtzia extract, product and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of an elsholtzia extract, a product and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing herba Moslae with water, and leaching to obtain herba Moslae extractive solution; concentrating the herba Moslae extract under reduced pressure, mixing with yeast, and fermenting to obtain herba Moslae fermentation broth; filtering the fermented liquid of herba Moslae, and drying. The invention uses high-pressure hot water for leaching, can improve the dissolution rate of the effective components in the elsholtzia, and is assisted by fermentation technology, thereby improving the biological activity of the effective components in the elsholtzia; the preparation process of the invention does not use any organic solvent or toxic or harmful chemical substances, is harmless to human bodies, is environment-friendly, can be applied to the fields of functional foods, health care products, medicines or functional cosmetics, and the like, and realizes industrial production.

title: Preparation method of yeast extract
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a yeast extract, belonging to the technical field of bioengineering. The method comprises the steps of mixing yeast cells subjected to fermentation culture, glycine and activated aspergillus oryzae mycelia, carrying out synergistic autolysis reaction under the mild condition of 45-60℃, pH and 4.5-6.5, and carrying out post enzymolysis and fine modification by utilizing trace amount of flavourzyme. By constructing the co-autolysis system, high-efficiency bioconversion is realized under mild conditions, and dependence on expensive exogenous enzymes is reduced. The prepared yeast extract has high free amino acid and taste nucleotide content, strong delicate flavor and coordinated flavor. The invention has simple process, low cost and easy industrialization, and provides a new scheme for producing high-quality natural seasonings.

title: Preparation method and application of poria cocos extract
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a poria cocos extract, which comprises the following preparation steps: taking dry poria cocos slices, crushing, grinding and screening to obtain poria cocos powder; adding absolute ethyl alcohol into the poria cocos powder, and uniformly stirring to obtain a mixed liquid; placing the mixed liquid A in a microwave reactor, performing microwave extraction, and performing suction filtration to obtain an alcohol-containing Poria cocos extracting solution A; adding the filter residue obtained in the step S3 into purified water, stirring uniformly, and heating and refluxing for extraction to obtain a water-containing poria cocos extracting solution B; mixing alcohol-containing Poria extract A and water-containing Poria extract B, stirring, and performing ultrasonic treatment to obtain mixed extract C; and (3) placing the mixed extracting solution C in a vacuum environment, concentrating into a paste, drying and crushing to obtain the poria cocos extract. The tuckahoe extract is taken as a food additive in food and beverage for a long time, so that the occurrence of metabolic diseases such as obesity, hyperlipidemia and the like can be reduced.

title: Natural excipient and method for making same
abstract: The present invention relates to a natural excipient composition capable of contributing to the promotion of public health by not adding chemical excipients such as silicon dioxide, magnesium stearate, and the like, which are commonly used in the manufacture of pharmaceuticals or functional foods, and a method for manufacturing the same. By adding seaweed powder, korean wheat, sweet potato starch, corn starch, and whole wheat powder, which are vegetable raw materials, it is an excellent invention that can contribute to a safe and safe and safe pharmaceutical composition or health functional food industry.

title: Mulberry enzyme and production process thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a mulberry enzyme and a production process thereof, wherein the formula comprises the following components: the production process of mulberry, white sugar and probiotics comprises the steps of selecting materials and preparing materials; step two, probiotic culture; step three, canning and fermenting; step four, filtering and purifying; step five, preparing mulberry enzyme; firstly, washing mulberry fruits serving as raw materials by using clear water, and then draining, removing stems and crushing for later use; activating the strain of the probiotics, and culturing for 48-72h to obtain a bacterial liquid of the probiotics for later use; the mulberry enzyme prepared by matching the mulberry, the white sugar and the probiotics has high nutritive value, and the raw materials have simple components and wide sources; through the use of probiotics, the mulberries are comprehensively fermented, so that the nutrients are micro-quantized and are more beneficial to the absorption of a human body; the production process used by the invention is simple and comprehensive, and is beneficial to popularization and use.

title: Plant nutrient solution
abstract: The invention discloses a plant nutrient solution which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 2-6 parts of Jingyang streptomycete, 4-8 parts of bacillus subtilis, 5-12 parts of bacillus amyloliquefaciens, 3-5 parts of bacillus mucilaginosus, 6-10 parts of bacillus laterosporus, 1-3 parts of rhodospirillum, 5-12 parts of sillimerian extract, 8-15 parts of pyrrosia breynia extract, 9-13 parts of sophora flavescens extract, 20-30 parts of macroelements, 0.05-2 parts of trace elements, 3-8 parts of vitamins and 1-3 parts of amino acids. The plant nutrient solution has the advantages of safe and easily-obtained raw materials, rich and balanced nutrition, comprehensive and efficient functions, and contribution to absorption and growth of plants.

title: Method to improve a plant's growth, development and resistance to (a)biotic stress
abstract: The present invention relates to a method to improve the growth, development and/or resistance to abiotic stress/biotic stress of a plant.

title: Microorganism combination, composite microbial agent and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a microorganism combination, a compound microbial inoculum and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of microbial fertilizers. The preservation number of the bacillus composts SR01-10 is CGMCC No.39418, and the preservation number of the bacillus composts SR01-9 is CGMCC No.39417. Both strains have the capabilities of decomposing cellulose, degrading protein, decomposing potassium, producing siderophores, degrading fat, dissolving inorganic phosphorus and the like, can antagonize plant pathogenic bacteria, and has good growth promoting effect on corn and strawberries. Compared with single strain application, the compound microbial inoculum formed by compounding SR01-10 and SR01-9 according to the proportion of 1:1 can exert the synergistic effect among strains, has more prominent effect on the growth promotion of strawberries and corns, has obviously stronger comprehensive growth promotion capability than two single strains, and has good development and application prospects.

title: Seed soaking, chest breaking and germination accelerating temperature control device
abstract: The invention relates to a seed soaking, chest breaking and germination accelerating temperature control device, which comprises a controller, a seed soaking box, a water storage tank and a heater, wherein the controller comprises: the seed soaking device is characterized in that the water storage tank is connected with a water source, a heater and a seed soaking tank, the water storage tank is connected with the seed soaking tank through a water conveying pipeline, the seed soaking tank is connected with the heater, a temperature sensor and a water level sensor are arranged in the seed soaking tank, and the controller executes instructions according to a set program to control other devices to work. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of accurate temperature setting, real-time control and the like.

title: Quick fertilizer injection unit of vegetable planting usefulness
abstract: The invention discloses a quick fertilizing device for vegetable planting, which comprises a greenhouse assembly, a frame and a thin film covering layer, wherein the thin film covering layer is arranged on the top of the frame, a fertilizing mechanism comprises a fertilizing support, the fertilizing support is of a grid-shaped pipeline structure with a plurality of groups of vertical distribution, a fertilizing dropper is arranged at a node of a grid, a spraying mechanism is arranged on the top of the frame and comprises a liquid drainage support, and a plurality of groups of spray heads are uniformly arranged below the liquid drainage support. According to the invention, the fertilizing mechanism correspondingly adds the nutrient solution required to be fertilized to the roots of the planted vegetables through the fertilizing dropper, the planting positions of the vegetables are distributed according to the positions of the fertilizing droppers, the liquid nutrient solution in the fertilizing frame is pressurized and conveyed to the fertilizing droppers of the fertilizing bracket through the pump, the quick and accurate fertilizing effect on the vegetables is realized, the pressure of the pump is uniformly distributed through the multi-connection block, and the uniformity of the fertilizing use is improved.

title: Transmitting apparatus and operating method thereof
abstract: According to the present invention, a transmitting apparatus comprises: an antenna module; a first communication module for transmitting and receiving signals via the antenna module with a first terminal served by the transmitting apparatus; and a processor electrically coupled to the first communication module. The processor obtains a channel matrix between terminals performing receive beamforming and the transmitting apparatus, obtains, from the obtained channel matrix, a first interference channel matrix corresponding to channel matrix between terminals other than the first terminal among the terminals and the transmitting apparatus, obtains, from the obtained first interference channel matrix, a second interference channel matrix satisfying an interference intensity condition, and determines a precoding matrix for a transmit stream of the first terminal based on a given precoding matrix and the obtained second interference channel matrix. Therefore, the present invention can minimize interference strength of transmit stream of a served terminal and determine an optimal precoding matrix for the transmit stream.

title: Apparatus and method of wireless communication
abstract: An apparatus and a method of wireless communication are provided. The method by a user equipment (UE) includes determining a first subframe, and/or determining a second subframe according to tire first subframe, and performing a physical downlink control channel (PDCCH) monitoring according to the first subframe and/or the second subframe. This can solve issues in the prior art, provide a method for UE operation in non-terrestrial network (NTN) Systems, reduce signaling overhead, provide a good communication performance, and/or provide high reliability.

title: Method and device for transmitting measurement reference signals
abstract: The invention provides a method and a device for transmitting a measurement reference signal, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining measurement reference signal information according to at least one of received signaling information and a convention rule, and transmitting the measurement reference signal according to the measurement reference signal information. By adopting the technical scheme, the information of the measurement reference signal is determined according to the signaling information, so that the measurement reference signal resource can adopt the time domain OCC, the capacity of the measurement reference signal is increased, and the coverage of the measurement reference signal is not influenced. The method solves the problem that the prior art has no effective technical proposal, and the capacity or coverage of a measurement reference signal is enhanced in new wireless.

title: Method for transmitting information and low-power wide area communication system
abstract: The application discloses a method for transmitting information and a low-power wide area communication system. The method obtains an initial signal through a spread spectrum modulation device. In the case where the initial signal is acquired, the initial signal is modulated by a packetized multilevel frequency shift keying and chirp signal to generate a modulated signal, which includes a preamble sequence, a frame control header, and a data payload. And transmitting the modulation signal to a spread spectrum demodulation device through a channel, and demodulating the frame control head and the data load by combining the leader sequence under the condition that the spread spectrum demodulation device receives the modulation signal so as to acquire information. The method and the device generate the modulation signals based on the grouped multi-system frequency shift keying and chirp signals, and demodulate the received modulation signals through the spread spectrum demodulation device, so that information is obtained, the performance of the signals in a complex electromagnetic environment can be stabilized, and the communication rate is improved.

title: Communication method and related product
abstract: The application discloses a communication method and related products. The method comprises the steps that network equipment sends first information, the first information is associated with the number K of frequency domain sub-bands corresponding to a first time domain unit, the frequency domain sub-bands comprise at least one resource block RB, the K frequency domain sub-bands are discontinuous in the frequency domain, K is an integer larger than 1, and terminal equipment receives the first information and sends pilot signals in the K frequency domain sub-bands. By adopting the method provided by the embodiment of the application, when the channel measurement is carried out based on SRS (sounding reference signal) transmitted by frequency hopping on a plurality of frequency domain sub-bands, the interpolation channel estimation accuracy of the rest unmeasured sub-bands is improved, and the performance of the channel measurement is further improved.

title: Medicine adding device
abstract: The utility model discloses a dosing device, which comprises a box body, wherein a metering pump is arranged at the top of the box body, a shell is fixedly connected with the top of the inner cavity of the box body, a stirring paddle is arranged in the inner cavity of the shell, an ultrasonic generator is arranged above the shell, one side of the stirring paddle is connected with an ultrasonic transducer through a buckle, a first conduction pipe is fixedly connected with the bottom end of the shell, a second three-way joint is arranged at the bottom end of the first conduction pipe, connecting pipes are inserted at both ends of the second three-way joint, a first stop valve is arranged at the outer side of the connecting pipes, a plastic hose is arranged at one end of the connecting pipes, a filter box is symmetrically and fixedly connected below the plastic hose, a metal filter screen is detachably connected at the inner side of the filter box, non-woven fabric filter cotton, by adjusting the first stop valve, the liquid medicine is injected into the other filter tank, so that the medicine adding device can continue to work normally.

title: Vertical liquid medicine soaking device
abstract: The invention discloses a vertical liquid medicine soaking device, which comprises a frame, a liquid medicine tank, a conveying device and a clamp module, wherein the liquid medicine tank is arranged on the frame and is provided with an inlet end and an outlet end, liquid medicine for soaking plate-shaped materials can be stored in the liquid medicine tank, the conveying device is arranged on the frame and extends at least from the inlet end to the outlet end, the conveying device is arranged above the liquid medicine tank, the clamp module is arranged on the conveying device and is provided with a clamping space for placing the plate-shaped materials, the clamp module can move in the liquid medicine tank along a first direction under the driving of the conveying device and can submerge the plate-shaped materials in the liquid medicine tank, the clamp module is provided with a plurality of clamp modules which are distributed at intervals along the first direction, and the thickness direction of the clamping space extends along the first direction. The technical scheme of the invention can reduce the production cost.

title: Liquid filling device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical equipment, and discloses a liquid filling device which comprises a pushing device and a liquid storage device; the pushing device comprises an air cylinder, a first through hole is formed in the top of the air cylinder, a connecting rod is arranged in the air cylinder, a piston is arranged on the connecting rod, the piston is positioned in the air cylinder, and the connecting rod penetrates through the first through hole and extends out of the air cylinder; the liquid storage device comprises two groups of liquid feeders, and each group of liquid feeders comprises a right-angle guide pipe, a liquid storage device and a connecting pipe. By arranging the pushing device and the liquid storage device, gas is continuously fed into the liquid storage device, so that the pressure in the liquid storage device is kept stable, on one hand, liquid to be filled is pushed into a patient, and the gas is continuously pushed, so that the liquid can be completely pushed out of the liquid storage device until the patient is in the body, and no medicine waste is caused; on the other hand, the continuously pushed gas can keep the pressure in the device unchanged, and can prevent liquid from flowing back during liquid exchange, thereby causing harm to intestines and stomach and polluting the liquid filling device.

title: Portable medical container
abstract: The invention discloses a portable medical container which comprises a shell, wherein a cleaning space is arranged in the shell, a rotating space is arranged in the lower end wall of the cleaning space, a supporting table is arranged on the upper end face of a driven shaft A in the rotating space, a plurality of fixedly connected suckers are arranged on the upper end face of the supporting table, a sealing cover is arranged at the upper end of the cleaning space, a pull rod is arranged in the sealing cover, a detachable cross brush is spirally connected to the lower end of the pull rod in a matching mode, and an ejection mechanism is arranged in the right end wall of the cleaning space. In the work of the invention, the medical container is fixed on the support table by the sucker to prevent the container from separating during cleaning, the detachable cross brush can be replaced by different types of cross brushes according to different types of containers to be cleaned, and the sealing cover effectively cuts off the contact between the external space and the cleaning space to prevent secondary bacterial pollution.

title: Medical surgical instrument fixing device
abstract: The application belongs to the field of medical instruments, and particularly relates to a medical surgical instrument fixing device which comprises a carrier, an external fixing component, a snake-shaped arm, a stretching device and a clamping component, wherein the snake-shaped arm and the stretching device are arranged on the carrier, the clamping component for clamping a surgical instrument is arranged at one end of the snake-shaped arm far away from the carrier, the external fixing component is used for fixing the carrier to the outside, when the connecting wire in the snake-shaped arm is in a loose state in use, the gesture of the snake-shaped arm is adjusted, so that the surgical instrument clamped by the clamping component at the front end of the snake-shaped arm reaches a required position and angle, and then the gesture of the snake-shaped arm is fixed by tensioning the connecting wire through the stretching device. The medical surgical instrument fixing device can be used for adjusting any omnibearing degree of freedom of a surgical instrument, is convenient to adjust, is not interfered by any outside, can completely replace medical staff supporting instruments, saves human resources, and effectively saves space resources of a surgical operation area with limited space.

title: Information processing apparatus, storage medium, and information processing method
abstract: The invention provides an information processing apparatus, a storage medium, and an information processing method, which can execute a processing request after determining a relevant user related to the processing request when the processing request is received from a processing request transmitting apparatus. An information processing apparatus is provided with a processor that receives a device ID and a processing request that identify the processing request transmitting device from the processing request transmitting device, and executes processing related to the processing request after determining a relevant user related to the processing request based on the device ID.

title: Information processing method, apparatus, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an information processing method, an information processing device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium; the related embodiments can be applied to various scenes such as cloud technology, artificial intelligence, intelligent transportation, auxiliary driving and the like. According to the method, after interaction information to be processed is obtained, interaction objects participating in interaction are extracted from the interaction information to be processed, after an interaction object set is obtained, target interaction information of each interaction object in the interaction object set is respectively screened out from a preset interaction information set, interaction characteristics of the interaction objects are extracted from the target interaction information, then the interaction characteristics are converted into time sequence characteristics, then the time sequence characteristics are fused to obtain target time sequence characteristics corresponding to the interaction information to be processed, and then target information of the interaction information to be processed is determined according to the target time sequence characteristics; the scheme can improve the accuracy of information processing.

title: Information display method, device and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides an information display method, information display equipment and a storage medium. In the information display method, when a first image area in the object distribution diagram is displayed, the first image area displayed in the interface can be updated to a second image area containing the selected object according to the position distribution data of the selected object in the position distribution diagram in response to the viewing operation of the selected object in at least one object contained in the object distribution diagram. Based on this, the content displayed by the interface can be quickly switched from the first image area to the second image area, which is beneficial to improving the efficiency of reviewing the selected object.

title: Information processing method, device, terminal and storage medium
abstract: The present disclosure provides an information processing method and apparatus, a terminal, and a storage medium. The information processing method comprises the following steps: displaying the first evaluation information and the second evaluation information in a first page; the first page comprises a first display area and a second display area, the first display area displays first evaluation information aiming at a preset user, and the second display area displays second evaluation information aiming at the preset user; and in response to the triggering operation of the first display area in the first page, displaying the first task information in the display area of the first evaluation information. By displaying the first task information in the display area of the first evaluation information and having the association relationship with the second evaluation information in time, the corresponding reference information can be provided in the page of the evaluation system, eliminating the need to manually input the first task information and improving the convenience of the user and the efficiency of information processing.

title: Information interaction method, system, electronic device and computer readable storage medium
abstract: In the embodiment of the invention, through acquiring the information of a seal and the information of a target task, the seal is used for packaging a target object of the corresponding target task, and the information of the seal and the information of the target task are associated so as to bind the seal and the target task. The binding relationship between the seal and the target task is established, so that the seal is irreplaceable, and therefore the embodiment of the invention can accurately determine whether the target object has an abnormal state in the task processing process based on the information of the seal of the packaged object in the target task, and the safety of the packaged object is improved.

title: Pump body assembly, rotary compressor and air conditioner
abstract: The invention provides a pump body assembly, a rotary compressor and an air conditioner. The pump body assembly comprises an exhaust cavity, wherein the exhaust cavity is provided with a first exhaust port, a silencer is arranged at the downstream of the first exhaust port and used for buffering and reducing noise of air flow exhausted by the first exhaust port, a second exhaust port is arranged on the silencer, the flow area of the first exhaust port is S1, the flow area of the second exhaust port is S0, and S0/S1 is less than 0.865. The pump body assembly, the rotary compressor and the air conditioner provided by the invention can reduce the oil discharge rate of the compressor, reduce the reliability risk of the compressor caused by insufficient lubrication due to the over high oil discharge rate, and improve the refrigerating capacity of the compressor to realize the high efficiency of the compressor.

title: Compressor assembly and temperature regulating device
abstract: The application discloses a compressor assembly and temperature regulating equipment, wherein the compressor assembly comprises a compressor shell, an impeller and regulating blades, a compression cavity and an air inlet channel communicated with the compression cavity are formed in the compressor shell, the impeller is rotatably arranged in the compression cavity, the regulating blades are rotatably arranged in the air inlet channel to regulate the air inflow of the air inlet channel, a rotating shaft of each regulating blade is orthogonal with the extending direction of the air inlet channel, and an air guide channel is formed on each regulating blade, so that the stability of the compressor under the working condition of small flow can be improved.

title: Cooling device and air supply device
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cooling device and air supply device, cooling device is used for the fan, including the casing, the casing connect in the structural wall of fan and follow the circumference setting of the air intake of fan, the inside of casing is formed with the cavity that is used for storing and/or circulate cooling medium for with the structural wall heat conduction of fan. Through the technical scheme, the cooling medium is stored and/or circulated in the cavity so as to be capable of heat-conducting and exchanging with the structural wall of the fan, and then the fan is radiated, in addition, the shell is arranged along the circumferential direction of the air inlet of the fan, so that the normal air inlet of the fan is not influenced, and the possibility of heating caused by the running resistance generated in the air inlet process of the fan is reduced.

title: Cooling device of air conditioner condenser and working method thereof
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a cooling device of an air conditioner condenser and a working method thereof, wherein the device comprises the following components: the water distribution structure comprises a water tank for storing condensed water, a spraying structure and an air pressure driving structure, and the spraying structure is connected with the water tank through a pipeline; the pneumatic driving structure is connected with the spraying structure. By implementing the device provided by the embodiment of the invention, the condensed water can be efficiently utilized and uniformly sprayed, and the space limitation and the functionality of the water distributor are comprehensively considered.

title: Sealing assembly, heat pump system and heating system
abstract: The application discloses a sealing assembly, a heat pump system and a heating system, wherein the sealing assembly comprises a shell, an impeller, a wheel cover and a bushing, an impeller cavity is formed in the shell, blades are formed on the impeller and are rotatably arranged in the impeller cavity, the wheel cover is arranged on the periphery of the impeller in a surrounding mode and is connected with the blades, a first sealing surface is formed on the peripheral surface of the wheel cover, the bushing is sleeved on the periphery of the wheel cover and is accommodated in the impeller cavity, a second sealing surface opposite to the first sealing surface is formed on the inner peripheral surface of the bushing, annular sealing teeth are formed on one of the first sealing surface and the second sealing surface, the annular sealing teeth are arranged at intervals in the axial direction, and a supporting boss is arranged between at least two adjacent annular sealing teeth, so that the sealing strength of the annular sealing teeth can be improved.

title: Cutting device for processing light guide plate
abstract: The utility model discloses a cutting device for processing a light guide plate, which comprises a box body, a workbench and a vertical plate; the conveying device is arranged, the light guide plate does not need to be moved manually, the workload can be reduced, and the conveying device is safe, convenient and quick and is provided with the accommodating groove, so that waste materials can be recycled; the screw rod is high in movement precision and low in energy consumption, and the sliding block and the clamping plate are arranged on the screw rod, so that the light guide plate can be clamped and cut better, and the cutting quality and the working efficiency are improved; cutting blade and cutting head can be changed at any time, and the cutting head is rotatable, makes cutting accuracy higher, has improved the cutting quality.

title: Plate shearing machine for plate processing
abstract: The utility model discloses a plate shearing machine for plate processing, which comprises an installation support, a conveying mechanism, a plate cutting mechanism and a driving mechanism, wherein the installation support is fixedly arranged on the plate shearing machine; the conveying mechanism, the plate cutting mechanism and the driving mechanism are all arranged on the mounting bracket; the plate cutting mechanism comprises a plate pressing mechanism, a cutter frame and a connecting plate; the cutter comprises a first cutter and a second cutter; the pressing plate mechanism comprises a connecting bolt, a pressing plate body and a spring; still be provided with the mounting hole on the connecting plate, connecting bolt passes the mounting hole and extends to the below of first cutter, and connecting bolt is provided with the spring with this body coupling of clamp plate in connecting bolt's the outside. Drive the cut trigger through actuating mechanism and reciprocate to the clamp plate body can also reciprocate along with the cut trigger, accomplishes reciprocal extrusion fixed to panel, does not accomplish the fixed to panel at needs manual work, has improved the cutting efficiency of panel, has reduced intensity of labour, has improved the practicality of device.

title: Clamping conveying device for machining
abstract: The application discloses a clamping and conveying device for machining, which relates to the field of clamping and conveying equipment and comprises a machining table, wherein two clamping rails are arranged above the machining table in parallel, first driving mechanisms for driving the two clamping rails to perform centering or separating movement are arranged on two sides of the clamping rails, elastic clamping assemblies for clamping workpieces are arranged on adjacent sides of the two clamping rails, lifting pieces for driving the first driving mechanisms to lift are arranged on two sides of the machining table, and a second driving mechanism for driving the elastic clamping assemblies to move with the workpieces is arranged on one side of the machining table. The application not only can carry out self-adaptive adjustment according to the small size difference of the same workpiece and stably clamp the workpiece, but also can adjust the clamping distance according to different types of workpieces, and has strong adaptability.

title: Press mounting device with automatic feeding and discharging function
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of press-fitting devices, and discloses a press-fitting device with automatic feeding and discharging, which comprises a press-fitting device and a material taking device, wherein the material taking device is arranged at the front side of the top end of the press-fitting device, the press-fitting device comprises a placing plate, the top end of the placing plate is fixedly connected with a supporting plate at the rear side, the top end of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a top plate, the top end of the placing plate is fixedly connected with a working shell at the rear side, two sides of the bottom end of the inner side wall of the working shell are respectively fixedly connected with a second telescopic rod, the top end of the working shell is fixedly connected with the press-fitting shell, and two sides of the bottom end of the inner side wall of the press-fitting shell are respectively provided with a top block. According to the utility model, the press-fitting device with automatic feeding and discharging functions is provided, the workpiece can be effectively ejected out by means of the second telescopic rod, and the workpiece can be effectively taken out by means of the material taking device and discharged by the conveyor belt.

title: 90-degree double-cylinder sleeve taking and placing device
abstract: The utility model discloses a 90-degree double-cylinder sleeve taking and placing device, which comprises a mounting seat; the rotating assembly is arranged on the mounting seat; the first cylinder sleeve grabbing assembly is arranged on the mounting seat; the second cylinder sleeve grabbing component is arranged on the rotating component and rotates along with the control of the rotating component; the first rotating angle control assembly is arranged on the mounting seat and used for limiting the rotation of the second cylinder sleeve grabbing assembly; and the second rotating angle control assembly is arranged on the mounting seat and is used for limiting the rotation of the second cylinder sleeve grabbing assembly. The utility model discloses can combine control system to realize automatic pack into 2 cylinder liners die casting machine's mould in, improve production efficiency, reduce personal safety hidden danger.

title: Transfer device for machinery
abstract: The utility model discloses a transfer device for machinery, which comprises a box body, wherein a through hole is formed in one side of the box body, a push rod is fixedly arranged on the other side of the box body, a base is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the box body, supporting legs are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the base, pulleys are arranged at the bottoms of the supporting legs, a protection mechanism is arranged on one side of the box body, the protection mechanism comprises a supporting plate, a sliding rail, a protection plate, a mounting block, a sliding block, a supporting plate, a mounting plate and a handle, the supporting plate is fixedly arranged on one side of the box body, the sliding rail is fixedly arranged on one side of the supporting plate, the protection plate is arranged on one side of the box body, and the mounting block is fixedly arranged on the front surface of the protection plate. Through being provided with protection machanism and having played the effect that one side of the box of being convenient for opens and closes, can open one side of box when making the bearing need take out from the box, be favorable to reducing the operation degree of difficulty and improve work efficiency.

title: Power transmission device
abstract: The invention discloses a power transmission device capable of suppressing unbalance of a first rotary member. The power transmission device is provided with a torque limiter and a vibration reduction unit. The torque limiter has a first side plate, a second side plate, and a friction plate. The vibration damping unit has a first rotating member, a second rotating member, and an elastic member. The first rotation member is configured to rotate integrally with the friction plate. The second side plate has an annular portion and a cylindrical portion. The annular portion extends in a circumferential direction. The cylindrical portion extends from an outer peripheral end portion of the annular portion toward the first side in the axial direction. The first rotating member has an outer peripheral surface that abuts an inner peripheral surface of the cylindrical portion.

title: Component supply device and component mounting device
abstract: The present invention is to suppress a decrease in the types of components that can be supplied to a component mounting device when scattered components are supplied to the component mounting device. The component mounting device includes: a motor; a first conveying belt which is driven by the motor, to convey a component put to an input position in a first direction; a vibrating body; and a conveying member which is vibrated by the vibrating body, to convey the component from the first conveying belt in the first direction and supply the same to a pickup position of a mounting head.

title: Multipurpose carrier flexible supporting device
abstract: The utility model relates to a multipurpose carrier flexible supporting device, comprising: the support for placing the automobile water tank and locate a plurality of locating components on the support, wherein the locating component is including being used for pressing from both sides in order to prevent its first locating component and the second locating component that rocks along the Y axle direction of automobile water tank top, is used for supporting tightly the third locating component of automobile water tank middle part one side, is used for supporting tightly the fourth locating component of automobile water tank middle part opposite side, is used for the location the fifth locating component of automobile water tank bottom, is used for supporting tightly the sixth locating component of automobile water tank bottom one side. Compared with the prior art, the utility model is suitable for assembling water tanks of various vehicle types, and has simple structure and high movement accuracy.

title: Automobile charging flap assembly and electric automobile
abstract: The invention discloses an automobile charging flap assembly and an electric automobile, and belongs to the technical field of automobiles. Through being equipped with at least one bolster on the rotor arm to when the rotor arm drives the lid and rotates, the rotor arm drives the sustainable extrusion casing of bolster rotation, when the lid was opened to the biggest angle process, last compress tightly between casing and the bolster, realize the linear absorption to the impact energy, can not shake when the lid is opened to the biggest position, and does not have more obvious striking sound, promotes the comfort that the user used.

title: Waste gas treatment equipment with activated carbon adsorption device
abstract: The invention relates to the field of waste gas treatment, in particular to waste gas treatment equipment with an activated carbon adsorption device, which comprises a shell, a conveying pipeline, a one-way valve, a mounting plate, an adsorption cavity and a treatment cavity, wherein the adsorption cavity and the treatment cavity are arranged in the shell; when handling waste gas, drive assembly through the operation of drive reciprocating mechanism and then drive the slider reciprocal slip in the admission line, and then with waste gas ration inhale behind the admission line rethread pipeline enter into and adsorb the chamber, install and to adsorb some dust particles in the chamber can with waste gas get rid of filtering piece, the setting is after the preliminary treatment is done to waste gas to the active carbon in the absorption chamber, gas passes through the pipe and enters into the treatment cavity, the treatment fluid in the treatment cavity can get rid of harmful gas, promote the quality to exhaust-gas treatment.

title: High-efficient whirl spray type industrial waste gas treatment equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of waste gas treatment, in particular to high-efficiency rotational flow spraying type industrial waste gas treatment equipment which comprises a plurality of supporting feet, a treatment box, a circulating assembly, a spraying assembly and a filtering mechanism, wherein the filtering mechanism comprises a filtering box, a treatment plate, a handle and two groups of sliding assemblies, each group of sliding assemblies comprises a sliding rail and two sliding blocks, the filtering box is arranged above the circulating assembly, the treatment plate is movably connected with the filtering box, the two groups of sliding assemblies are symmetrically arranged in the filtering box, the sliding rails are fixedly connected with the filtering box, the two sliding blocks are movably connected with the sliding rails, the treatment plate is fixedly connected with the two sliding blocks, and the handle is fixedly connected with the treatment plate.

title: A filter edulcoration device for sludge treatment
abstract: The invention provides a filtering and impurity removing device for sludge treatment, which belongs to the technical field of sludge impurity removing and comprises a first mounting frame and a second mounting frame, wherein an inner cylinder and an outer cylinder are respectively arranged between the first mounting frame and the second mounting frame, the inner cylinder is positioned in the outer cylinder, driving mechanisms are arranged on the first mounting frame, the inner cylinder and the outer cylinder, a discharging channel is arranged between the first mounting frame and the second mounting frame at the lower side of the outer cylinder, a receiving channel is arranged at one side, far away from the discharging channel, of the second mounting frame, a cleaning plate is arranged between the inner cylinder and the outer cylinder, and a braking mechanism is also arranged in the second mounting frame. The invention solves the problems that the prior sludge is easy to cause mesh blockage after long-term use when being filtered, the solution to the mesh blockage problem of the filter cylinder is mainly to stop for blockage removal or rely on an external mechanical device for blockage removal, and has the defects of inconvenient operation, low efficiency and the like, and is easy to cause secondary pollution discharge and increase the production cost.

title: Adsorption device and oil smoke clarifier
abstract: The invention provides an adsorption device and an oil fume purifier, relating to the technical field of purification equipment, wherein the adsorption device provided by the invention comprises: the heat collecting cover assembly, the shell and the heat exchange assembly; the heat collecting cover assembly is arranged at two ends of the shell, the heat exchange assembly is arranged inside the shell, the heat collecting cover assembly is provided with a heat flow side inlet and a heat flow side outlet which are communicated with the heat exchange assembly through a heat flow channel, the shell is provided with a cold flow side inlet and a cold flow side outlet which are communicated through a cold flow channel, and an adsorption unit is arranged in the cold flow channel. The invention solves the technical problems that the adsorption component needs to be replaced frequently, the material consumption cost is high, the solid waste maintenance cost is high and the environmental pollution is easily caused in the related technology.

title: Quick preparation facilities of material decontaminates
abstract: The utility model discloses a rapid preparation device of decontaminating materials, which belongs to the technical field of decontaminating material preparation, and comprises a preparation vehicle and two raw material storage tanks fixed in the preparation vehicle, wherein pneumatic pumps are arranged at the top ends of the two raw material storage tanks, the pneumatic pumps are communicated with the bottom of the raw material storage tanks through connecting pipes, two sides of the top end surface of each pneumatic pump are respectively connected with a compressed gas cylinder and a release pipe, a first ball valve is arranged at the top end of each connecting pipe, and a proportional mixing pipe is arranged at the bottom end of each connecting pipe.

title: Signal receiver and signal transceiver
abstract: The invention provides a signal receiver and a signal transceiver capable of preventing leakage current. The signal receiver includes a pair of terminal switches, a first resistor, a second resistor, and a pull-down circuit. The terminal switch receives the operation power. The pair of terminal switches have a common control terminal. The first resistor is coupled between the first signal input terminal and the common control terminal. The second resistor is coupled between the second signal input terminal and the common control terminal. The pull-down circuit is coupled between the common control terminal and the reference voltage terminal. The pull-down circuit determines whether to pull down the first control voltage on the common control terminal to the reference voltage according to the enable state or the power-off state of the signal receiver.

title: Low-voltage high-speed programmable equalization circuit
abstract: The invention relates to a low-voltage high-speed programmable equalization circuit, which comprises a gain boosting amplifying stage, a CML differential amplifying stage and an emitter follower, wherein the input end of the gain boosting amplifying stage is an input end of the equalization circuit, and the output end of the gain boosting amplifying stage is connected with the input end of the CML differential amplifying stage; the output end of the CML differential amplification stage is connected with the input end of the emitter follower; and the output end of the emitter follower is the output end of the equalizing circuit. According to the invention, one path of an input signal passes through a pure resistance network full-path and the other path passes through a resistance-capacitance network high-path through a gain boosting amplifying stage, so that high-pass filtering is realized, and the effective high-speed signal loss is reduced to the minimum; and the two variable current sources in the gain boosting amplifying stage realize that the equalizing compensation size is programmable, and the proportion of the two variable current sources is adjusted according to different cable lengths of different application scenes, so that proper equalizing compensation is realized, and various application requirements are met.

title: Driving circuit
abstract: The invention discloses a driving circuit, which comprises an edge modulation circuit, an isolation transformer, an energy storage circuit, a demodulation circuit and a switch control circuit, wherein the edge modulation circuit is connected with the isolation transformer; wherein, demodulation circuit includes: the voltage stabilizing circuit comprises a diode D2, a diode D3, a voltage stabilizing tube Z3, a voltage stabilizing tube Z4, a switch tube S1, a switch tube S2, a resistor R1 and a voltage stabilizing unit; the invention can respond to the modulated positive and negative voltages transmitted from the primary winding of the isolation transformer to the secondary winding, demodulate the positive voltage with a certain amplitude on the secondary winding of the isolation transformer into an on signal to drive the power semiconductor device to be on, demodulate the negative voltage with a certain amplitude on the secondary winding of the isolation transformer into an off signal to drive the power semiconductor device to be off, and flexibly improve the anti-interference capability of the circuit and prevent the false on and false off by increasing the on and off threshold values of the signal demodulation circuit.

title: Power conversion device and control method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a power conversion device and a control method thereof and, more specifically, to a power conversion device which may protect a switching element when performing stopping of driving, and a control method thereof. A power conversion device according to an embodiment of the present disclosure comprises a pulse width modulation (PWM) controller for outputting, to a gate driver, a first pulse width modulation signal for controlling a first switching element, a second pulse width modulation signal for controlling a second switching element, a third pulse width modulation signal for controlling a third switching element, and a fourth pulse width modulation signal for controlling a fourth switching element.

title: Signal attached single firewire power control system and method
abstract: The present invention provides a signal attached single firewire power control system and method, comprising a linear regulator, a switch cutoff module, and a controller. The linear regulator is disposed between the input terminal and the output terminal to stabilize a minimum voltage difference between the input terminal and the output terminal. The switch intercepting module includes a MOSFET switch disposed between the input terminal and the output terminal, a driver connected to the MOSFET switch gate, and a voltage feedback control circuit connected to the driver. The controller outputs a pulse modulation signal to the driver according to the control command to output a control signal via the MOSFET switch, while the voltage feedback control circuit is powered by the single fire line circuit.

title: Deep learning-based method for segmenting a continuous glucose data into fasting state and post-meal state and a system thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a method and a system for separating postprandial blood sugar from continuous blood sugar data based on deep learning. More specifically, the present invention relates to a method and a system for separating postprandial blood sugar from continuous blood sugar data based on deep learning, which can separate a postprandial blood sugar section from continuous blood sugar data of a subject using an artificial neural network, so that it is possible to analyze postprandial blood sugar without a separate food intake and meal record of the subject, and does not require personal information such as the age and gender of the subject, thereby further improving user accessibility. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method for separating postprandial blood sugar from continuous blood sugar data based on deep learning, which is a method for separating a postprandial blood sugar section from continuous blood sugar data of a subject using an artificial neural network, comprises: a postprandial blood sugar section data generation step of measuring continuous blood sugar of a first subject and recording a food intake time to generate postprandial blood sugar section data; an artificial neural network model training step of predicting a postprandial blood sugar section from the measured continuous blood sugar data of the first subject and training an artificial neural network model based on the postprandial blood sugar section data indicating information on an actual postprandial blood sugar section and a loss function value between the predicted postprandial blood sugar sections; and a postprandial blood sugar section prediction step of inputting continuous blood sugar data of a second subject to the trained artificial neural network model to predict a postprandial blood sugar section in the continuous blood sugar data of the second subject.

title: Ash removal device is used in production of power on box
abstract: The utility model discloses an ash removal device for producing an upper electric box body, which relates to the technical field of upper electric box bodies and comprises an ash removal device box body, wherein a movable door is arranged on the outer wall of the front side of the ash removal device box body, a top cover is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the top of the ash removal device box body, a rotating motor is fixedly arranged in an inner cavity of the top cover, the outer wall of an output shaft of the rotating motor penetrates through the inner wall of the middle end of the top of the ash removal device box body, and a turntable is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the top end of the output shaft of the rotating motor. According to the utility model, after the movable door is closed, the rotating motor in the top cover is started, so that the rotary table can be driven to rotate, the brush at the bottom of the box top cleaning disc is utilized to clean the top of the electric box body, and the rotary table rotates and simultaneously drives the sponge rotary drum to rotate through the driving motor, so that longer cleaning cotton wires can clean the side surface of the box body rapidly, and the effects of relieving manual ash cleaning pressure, and simultaneously realizing quick and thorough ash cleaning are achieved through a full-automatic ash cleaning method.

title: Intelligent textile fabric quality detection method and system
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent textile fabric quality detection method and system, which relate to the technical field of textile fabric quality detection and comprise the steps of carrying out data acquisition, type processing and feature extraction analysis on textile fabrics through a plurality of sensor groups, carrying out fabric feature positioning, obtaining type abnormal distribution information according to fabric feature positioning information, carrying out quantity and range comparison analysis on the type abnormal distribution information, carrying out abnormality degree analysis when one type of comparison analysis result is normal in characteristic and the other type of comparison analysis result is abnormal in characteristic, further determining abnormal types of fabrics, obtaining a type number ratio according to the abnormal type number of fabrics and the normal type number of fabrics, carrying out abnormality judgment on the textile fabrics according to the type number ratio, and obtaining fabric abnormality judgment information.

title: Mass output controlled vaporizer
abstract: A vaporizer device includes a resistive heating element; circuitry configured to control delivery of electrical power to the resistive heating element from a power source; and a controller configured to perform operations including: receiving inputs representative of a power delivery to the resistive heating element, a temperature of the resistive heating element, and/or a flow rate of air past the resistive heating element; predicting, using the received inputs, an amount of evaporation of the vaporizable material at the resistive heating element; and controlling the power delivery to the resistive heating element in response to the predicted amount of evaporation of the vaporizable material, the controlling including increasing or decreasing an instantaneous power delivery to the heating element such that a target aerosol yield is produced. Related devices, systems, methods, and articles are also described.

title: Measuring device with marking function
abstract: The invention discloses a measuring device with a marking function, and relates to the technical field of measuring robots; to implement the functionality of the marker; the method comprises the following steps: the device comprises a device main body, wherein two sides of the device main body are rotatably provided with running wheels through wheel shafts, and the wheel shafts are provided with angle sensors; the marking wheel is rotatably arranged on the inner wall of one side of the device main body through a rotating shaft, and the circumferential outer wall of the marking wheel is provided with accommodating cavities which are uniformly distributed; the transmission shaft is rotatably arranged on the inner wall of one side of the device main body. By arranging the structures such as the feeding barrel and the marking wheel, the powder storage cavity can convey the powder to the ground when the powder storage cavity rotates to the lower part based on the running of the running wheel, so that the purpose of marking is achieved; in the mode, the diameters of the running wheel and the marking wheel are fixed, and the transmission ratios of the gear transmission assembly and the toothed chain transmission assembly are fixed, so that the purpose of equidistant marking can be achieved.
